checks.title: CPU & memory
checks.summary: Load is healthy (0.2), 2.0 GiB RAM free of 7.7 GiB.

checks.title: Disk space
checks.recommendation: Prune old Docker images: `docker image prune -a` frees ~6 GB.
checks.explain: How full the server's main disk is. Above ~85 % databases and logs start failing in odd ways, and a full disk can stop every service at once.

actions.label: Ask the assistant
actions.prompt: The server disk is getting full (Root filesystem 78% full (137 GB free).). Find what takes the most space and suggest safe cleanups — do not delete anything without asking.

checks.title: SSH root login
checks.summary: PermitRootLogin is disabled and password auth is off.
checks.explain: Whether someone can log in as root over SSH. Attackers try root first; turning it off removes the most guessed account.

checks.title: fail2ban
checks.summary: Active — 3 IPs currently banned on the sshd jail.
checks.explain: fail2ban blocks addresses that keep failing to log in, which turns brute-force attempts into a few tries.

checks.title: Container image updates
checks.recommendation: Review and apply from the Updates tab; snapshots let you roll back.

checks.title: Volume backups
checks.summary: No backup ran in the last 7 days for 'cloud' and 'vault'.
checks.recommendation: Set up a scheduled volume backup — this is your biggest risk.
checks.explain: Whether this server's data is copied somewhere else on a schedule. Without backups, one failed disk loses everything.

actions.label: Ask the assistant
actions.prompt: This server has no backup set up. Suggest a simple, reliable backup for its Docker volumes and configs to an external disk or another server.

checks.title: Exposed ports
checks.summary: Only 80/443 are public; everything else is bound to localhost.
checks.explain: Ports published on all interfaces are reachable from your network, and from the internet if your router forwards them. Internal services are safer behind the reverse proxy.
